title: cosim.fmi: the FMI co-simulation master algorithm judged by its own shipped number — every run reports its split-vs-monolithic deviation; first-order-hold iteration cuts it ~19× at H = 0.05, and real FMU coupling refuses by name to SXE-15
author: muse-b3
covers: Hand recipe (kind repro-steps) for SX-XC-08, authored by muse-b3 as author of record (standing Batch B authorship, CB-0820/CB-0823) from the fixer's supplied content: /Users/dutch/.zuko/quality/CHECK-SX-XC-08.md (seat B2, branch sx/solver-core, PRG-01) and the shipped solver doc docs/conkay/solvers/cosim.fmi.md, build a0f25e31d (landed 2026-11-18 under the founder's quality-work word on the standing evidence bar). Value-assertion provenance: INDEPENDENT — expected values from the cited source (the FMI standard, fmi-standard.org, free) and the reference system's analytic normal modes ω = √(8 ∓ 2√10), computed independently in the CI suite by mode superposition; the checker re-pulls the source and recomputes (DC-01); a SELF-REFERENCED value, if one is ever substituted, is drift coverage only and never correctness evidence. Foundation gating at f4f1f77ff (fixer's evidence): the solve.direct reachability leg is expected-fail until SC-00 is seated/built; the bare-number adversarial leg is expected-fail until the SC-04 refusal leg is built; the integrity pin runs the armed direct-envelope shape until the IR-path integrity arm is built. discriminator: Pre-fix discriminator transcript (replayed 2026-11-17 against f4f1f77ff, from CHECK-SX-XC-08.md): registry probe over the 124 solvers registered at the ref returns cosim.fmi → ABSENT; conkay_solver_list does not list it and the reference case cannot run. (Catalogue row status: missing.) Foundation legs at the same ref (CHECK-SC-FOUNDATIONS-B2.md): solve.direct absent (conkay_solve requires an IR); a bare number on a dimensional field is silently accepted as SI; the input-integrity guard is unarmed on the IR path.
steps: Replay via MCP conkay_solve {solver_id: cosim.fmi, typed inputs from the reference case} (or solve.direct once SC-00 lands): {m1: 1, m2: 1, k1: 4, kc: 6, initial: {x1: 1, v1: 0, x2: 0, v2: 0}, tEnd: 2, method: "gauss-seidel", stepSize: 0.005, iterate: {tolerance: 1e-10, maxIterations: 20}}, target cosim → PASS with maxDeviation < 2e-3 — the split run judged against the monolithic integration and the analytic normal modes ω = √(8 ∓ 2√10) (mode superposition computed independently), never against the solver's own output alone.

Deviation-discipline leg: every run ships its split-vs-monolithic deviation (max |split − monolithic| over all four states at macro-step boundaries, the monolithic integrated at stepSize/20 RK4 in the same run) — the number a master algorithm is judged by, reported, never hidden; undamped runs also report total-energy drift, and non-converged coupling steps are counted and warned, never silent. Ordering legs: without iteration the coupling is zero-order hold (the FMI default) with first-order error in H (measured ~3.7·H) and Jacobi's deviation exceeds Gauss–Seidel's; with iterate set, the fixed-point coupling runs under first-order hold and cuts the deviation >5× (measured ~19× at H = 0.05), restoring second-order scaling — iterating the zero-order-hold map instead is a dissipative implicit scheme with a worse constant, measured and rejected in the build, and must not reappear.

Engine-tier leg: target fmu → NOT_COMPUTED requires_engine_tier:sxe-15 — real FMU import and coupling (Modelica, Chrono, CFD/FEA binaries) is SXE-15's tier, refused by name, never approximated in JS; with the engine absent the engine path shows NOT_COMPUTED engine_unavailable:sxe-15 with install hint, never a fallback number labelled as the engine result; engine crash/timeout/non-convergence → engine_failed / engine_not_converged.

Adversarial: NaN / 1e300 / negative-where-physical-positive input (masses, stiffnesses, step size) → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; a missing required property → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field, no assumed value unless declared and echoed as defaulted (SC-03); a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted (inputs used == inputs submitted); non-FMI-compliant units → NOT_COMPUTED/WARN naming the violated bound; a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
